title: Noncurrent Note Receivable [Stated Rate = 0%; Market Rate = 10%]

items.concept: Initial recognition of 0% noncurrent note at FV of inventory; effective-interest subsequent measurement schedule; period-end discount amortization JEs; maturity collection of face
Number-variant twin: 0% noncurrent note measured at PV (market 10%); equipment sale with loss; effective-interest schedule; period-end amort JEs; face collection at maturity
Period-end adjusting when note anniversary ≠ fiscal year-end—build note-year amort schedule, then allocate discount amortization (interest revenue) to calendar reporting periods; maturity settlement
Classification / measurement — initial sales amount vs face; interest revenue equals discount amortization when stated rate is zero
